cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Grandad's embarrassed about the gazebo. Let's tell everyone the party moved indoors because the garden's unavailable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's already told Aunt Jean he set it on fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then we all say, 'Everyone's fine; we're celebrating indoors.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Jean wants him to explain it in his birthday speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's his opening sentence too. Then straight to thanking her for the trifle.
